formulas.ascii: p = min(m (M + 1), P + 1) / (P + 1); g = #{p in 1..P : q_p >= q_0}, l = #{q_p <= q_0}, where q_0 is the pair sum of the identity permutation and q_p that of permutation p; the default two-sided tail has m = 2 and M = min(g, l) (greater: m = 1, M = g; lesser: m = 1, M = l; folded: m = 1, M = #{|s_p - mean| >= |s_0 - mean|}; directed: m = 1, M = min(g, l)). The statistic is s = kappa q with a positive constant kappa, so the counts compare identical f32 pair sums. z = (s_0 - mean) / sd of the P simulated statistics (esda z_sim). The p-value lies on the grid k/(P+1).
